dict.Animația se face din straturi: fiecare s: The animation is made from layers: each layer with pixels is a frame, from bottom to top. Add at least two layers, or press ＋ New Frame and change the copy a little.
dict.Arată cadrul și alege stratul lui (ca să: Show the frame and select its layer (to change it)
dict.Trăsăturile au marginea estompată, ca o: Strokes have a feathered edge, like a soft brush: the selection fades gradually toward the edge
dict.Masca vectorială a stratului ales din tr: Vector mask of the selected layer from the open path (the path is kept and can be changed later)
dict.Schimbi masca vectorială: mută punctele: You are changing the vector mask: move the path points, then ◐ Mask updates it.
dict.Scoate masca vectorială (rămâne masca de: Remove the vector mask (the mask from before it remains)
dict.Traseul din care e făcută masca stratulu: The path the selected layer's mask is made from: move the points, then ◐ Mask updates it
dict.Cadru gol: zona aleasă devine un loc pen: Empty frame: the selected area becomes a placeholder for a picture (gray, with an X); then drag a picture onto it, or select its layer and use 🖼 From File…
dict.Cât stă cadrul pe ecran: How long the frame stays on screen
dict.Copie a cadrului ales, pusă deasupra lui: A copy of the selected frame, placed above it: change it a little so things move
dict.Cronologie: animație din cadre; fiecare: Timeline: frame animation; each layer is a frame with its own duration, played here and saved as GIF
dict.Redă animația la nesfârșit, cu durata fi: Play the animation in a loop, with each frame's duration
dict.Salvează animația ca GIF animat (se repe: Save the animation as an animated GIF (loops forever)
